title: Moderators' Incentives [Postpaid Proposal]
body:
## Date: 2nd May 2022

**Contributors:** Community Mods & Regional Mods

**NSP:** Shankar Warang, Edgeware Agency

**Overview:**
	This proposal aims to incentivize the contributions from Community Mods and Regional Mods in April 2022.

**Reference:** [Introducing Moderators' Recruitment Quiz: Decentralising Community Moderation](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/2938-introducing-moderators-recruitment-quiz-decentralising-community-moderation)

**Primary deliverables:**
- Answer/assist/engage across TG, Discord and Element
- Remove any kind of spam


**Optional deliverables:**
- Constructive discussions
- Increase community-wide engagement
- Collect different types of feedback from the community members
- Community events


**How we incentivized the contributions from the Community Mods so far:**
- Jan 2022: [Bounty #3](https://edgeware.subscan.io/extrinsic/0x820002e2582982fd37d1ce4c5d20c33dfce067f8c8dd1c94367c9177d846a940?event=10326459-1)
- Feb 2022: [Treasury Tip](https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury_tip/0xa4316a2dc989b3cd4c113bb45f19e02694b8bb3eb856a5cabd9279ee17240cff)
- March 2022: [Treasury Proposal #59](https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury/59) ([SuperMajority Referendum #69](https://edgeware.subscan.io/referenda/69))

**Incentives:**
	Incentives for Community Mods: 500 USD equivalent per month for daily 6 hours of moderation.
	Total number of Community Mods: 4

	Incentives for solo Regional Mod: 125 USD per month
	Total number of Regional Mods: 4
